result.description: A fictional 32-inch widescreen monitor designed for studio layout and multi-window visualization. The Kestrel Arc Monitor 32QW features a matte IPS panel, 2560 x 1440 resolution, 165 Hz refresh rate, and 1 ms response tuning for smooth desktop motion. It includes DisplayPort 1.4, dual HDMI 2.1 inputs, a USB-C upstream port with 90 W power delivery, and an adjustable ergonomic stand for tilt, swivel, pivot, and height control.
